properties.description: Hermetic. It builds a throwaway git repository with a tag holding no design, a tag in the single-file layout and a tag in the item layout, and checks three things: the manifest is never counted in `links`; both layouts give the same counts; the empty tag is named in `skipped`. It also checks the weekly selection. CI runs it (ci.yml), and AGENTS.md lists it. Seen failing when count_design was mutated to count INCLUDES in `links`.
properties.name: tools/test_site_counts.py — the site counts' own net: manifest apart, both layouts alike, an empty tag named, one point a week
